data.title: Calidi Biotherapeutics Received NYSE American Notification Letter Regarding Stockholders’ Equity Deficiency
data.description: On September 21, 2026, Calidi Biotherapeutics, Inc. (NYSE American: CLDI) announced that it received a notice from NYSE American LLC stating that the Company was not meeting the NYSE American's listing standards. The specific deficiency was related to Part 10, Section 1003(a)(ii) of the NYSE American Company Guide, which requires a minimum stockholders' equity of $4.0 million if a company has reported losses in three of its four most recent fiscal years. The Notice also mentioned that the Company does not currently qualify for any exemptions outlined in Section 1003(a) of the Company Guide, which includes the exemption for companies with market capitalization exceeding $50 million.

data.title: Quest PharmaTech Announces Change of Chief Executive Officer
data.description: Quest PharmaTech Inc., a Canadian pharmaceutical company listed on TSX-V as QPT, has disclosed that as of November 23, 2026, their current Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Dr. Madi Madiyalakan, will retire from the position. Dr. Madiyalakan, who has been with Quest as CEO since August 2006, will be succeeded by Mr. Jeffrey Shon, a current director at Quest. Mr. Shon brings a wealth of experience in legal, regulatory, and corporate affairs, as well as venture capital funding for emerging technologies. This change in leadership marks a significant transition for the company.

data.title: Future Money Acquisition Corporation Announces Receipt of Nasdaq Delinquency Notice Regarding Delayed Form 10-Q Filing
data.description: San Francisco, California - Future Money Acquisition Corporation (Nasdaq: FMAC) disclosed that on September 22, 2026, it received a deficiency notice from Nasdaq due to the Company's failure to submit its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter concluding on July 31, 2026. According to Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1), companies listed are mandated to promptly file all necessary periodic reports with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The company is now not in compliance with this regulation.

data.title: Netcapital Inc. Receives Nasdaq Notice Related to Delayed Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q
data.description: On September 21, 2026, Netcapital Inc. (Nasdaq: NCPL) received a notice from Nasdaq, indicating that the company is not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) as it has not filed its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended July 31, 2026. Additionally, Netcapital Inc. remains delinquent in filing its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended April 30, 2026. This rule mandates listed companies to promptly file all necessary periodic financial reports with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

data.title: WISeKey Announces Planned Effectiveness of Redomiciliation from Switzerland to the British Virgin Islands
data.description: Zug, Switzerland - September 25, 2026: WISeKey International Holding Ltd, traded on SIX as WIHN and NASDAQ as WKEY, has announced the anticipated completion of its redomiciliation from Switzerland to the British Virgin Islands on October 2, 2026. This move will occur through a cross-border merger with WISeKey merging into its British Virgin Islands unit, WISeQey Corp. (previously named WISeKey International Corp.), which will continue as the surviving entity. The legal effectiveness of this merger and redomiciliation is expected on October 2, 2026, pending the finalization of registration processes.

data.title: Pool Corporation Announces Director Appointment
data.description: On September 25, 2026, Pool Corporation (Nasdaq: POOL) based in Covington, Louisiana, disclosed that Jean-Marc Germain has been appointed to the Board of Directors following a recommendation from the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee. The appointment of Mr. Germain will officially commence on September 30, 2026, and his term will continue until the annual meeting of shareholders in 2027, where he will be up for election by Pool Corporation’s shareholders. With the addition of Mr. Germain, the Board will now be comprised of a total of nine directors.

data.title: New Data Highlight Artera's MMAI Consistency Across Diverse Patient Populations at ASTRO 2026
data.description: Artera, a company specializing in multimodal artificial intelligence (MMAI) cancer tests, will be highlighted in upcoming data showcased at the 2026 American Society for Radiation Oncology (ASTRO) Annual Meeting. This new information presents promising evidence of MMAI's capabilities in providing reliable insights applicable to a variety of patient demographics and medical scenarios. The studies underscore MMAI's potential in delivering consistent and significant information. This breakthrough could lead to more personalized treatment approaches.

data.title: MVB Bank Announces Strategic Partnership With DingoBlu Financial
data.description: A financial technology company, DingoBlu Financial, Inc., based in Fairmont, W.Va., revealed a pivotal alliance with MVB Bank, Inc., aimed at launching their mobile-first platform offering personal financial products. The partnership marks a crucial step forward for DingoBlu in bringing its suite of financial products to the market. As a Visa fintech partner, DingoBlu's debit card program is set to operate on the Visa network with the support of its bank affiliate, MVB Bank. This collaboration represents a significant move for DingoBlu as they gear up to roll out their innovative platform and services.

data.title: TNS to Tackle Cross-Channel Fraud and Customer Trust in Two Sessions at CFCA Fall Educational 2026
data.description: In Reston, Virginia, a report on communications fraud highlighted the evolving tactics used by bad actors, who target various channels like voice, messaging, email, applications, and social media. They often spoof phone numbers of financial institutions to deceive customers and take advantage of fragmented intelligence systems that make prevention challenging. This has led to a growing trust gap among consumers, with an increasing wariness towards even legitimate communications. The report emphasized the need for unified strategies across industries and countries to combat this issue effectively. #CFCAFall2026.
